sentence: The valuation premium favors state ownership, vanishes in polluting industries without a green transition the market finds credible, and appears only where asset structures stay light
passage: [Shi et al. (2025), p. 1] "Three heterogeneity tests reveal boundary conditions: the valuation premium is stronger for state-owned enterprises, disappears in heavily polluting industries unless AI is part of a credible green transition, and is evident only in non-asset-intensive firms where resource reconfiguration is agile."

gemini.overclaim: without a green transition the market finds credible
gemini.note: The sentence shifts the emphasis by omitting the passage's specific requirement that AI must be part of the credible green transition.
